- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.75) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly to align with mean reversion.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.50), model often underestimates; adjust upward to reflect potential rebound.
- Model frequently overshoots after recent price spikes (especially >68.00), leading to overcorrection; apply dampening factor of 0.95 to peak forecasts.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag in capturing short-term sentiment shifts; use sentiment from last 5 days as weighting for next 3-5 days.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model tends to misalign with cycle midpoint; anchor forecast to 3-day moving average of recent 18-day history.
- When sentiment is flat (0.00–0.25) or mixed, model often drifts toward historical mean; use 18-day rolling mean as baseline correction.
